title: AI Compass
subtitle: A structured 1-to-5 star diagnostic that benchmarks digital maturity, data infrastructure, and AI deployment readiness — before capital is committed.

sections.heading: What AI Compass Measures
sections.body:
AI Compass™ evaluates an organisation across four navigational points:

\- Direction — Is the AI deployment aimed at the right business problem, with a clear hypothesis?

\- Value — Does the model create measurable, decision-driving value — or just produce dashboards?

\- Readiness — Do people, processes, and data infrastructure support deployment without creating insider risk?

\- Integrity — Is the system lawful, auditable, and architecturally compliant with GDPR and sector-specific regulation?

sections.heading: The 5-Tier Maturity Scale
sections.body:
AI Compass benchmarks capabilities on a 1-to-5 star scale:

1★ Fragmented — Manual PDF workflows, no structured data layer, decisions made by instinct.

2★ Structured — Basic reporting, spreadsheet-driven analytics, partial digitisation.

3★ Integrated — API-connected systems, descriptive analytics, some automation.

4★ Predictive — Machine learning models informing decisions, governed data pipelines.

5★ Autonomous — Fully automated, predictive AI with closed-loop compliance and real-time governance.

Most early-stage ventures arrive at 1–2★. AI Compass maps the gap and prescribes a sequenced path forward.

sections.heading: Data Infrastructure & Automated Compliance
sections.body:
Before deploying AI algorithms, systems must be data-ready. AI Compass audits pipeline architecture, synthetic identity integrity, and automated governance to ensure models remain performant, audit-compliant, and legally defensible.

In regulated sectors, this is not optional — it is the difference between a competitive moat and a regulatory liability. The diagnostic output feeds directly into the Polaris Sprint design and the 6Sense qualification score.

sections.heading: How to Engage
sections.body: AI Compass is deployed as part of the Attolloo EaaS engagement — typically following initial 6Sense qualification screening. If you want to understand where your organisation sits on the maturity scale, reach out: nils.johan@attolloogroup.com
